title: Deliver
headline: *Deliver*
sub: Send an order with a rider, and see where it is.

recap.en: Nneka has paid. The dress must reach her before Saturday.
recap.pcm: Nneka don pay. The dress must reach her before Saturday.

flow.purpose: the rider collects the garment bag
flow.action: Rides up to the workroom door on a small dark-pine motorcycle, takes a garment bag from Zainab's hand, and secures it on his back with a two-finger salute
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier doorway, Surulere, a yellow-painted wall, mid-morning sun
flow.camera: tracking shot beside the bike, eye-level

flow.action: Opens her front door, sees a garment bag, gasps with both hands to her cheeks, then laughs with delight

bridge.en: Delivered. But Ada's Kitchen has sent a big order: fifty uniforms. Zainab cannot sew them alone.
bridge.pcm: E don reach. But Ada's Kitchen don send big order: fifty uniform. Zainab no fit sew them alone.

en: Emeka is free and covers Surulere.
Later, the Orders tab lists the order.
He picks it up. On the way.
pcm: Emeka free and e dey cover Surulere.
Later, the Orders tab go list the order.
E pick am up. E dey road.
E don deliver, with the time.
